A repo link [the pane](src/Pane.h) is not a web link, a [script link](javascript:window.pwned=4) never opens, and an image ![diagram](https://example.org/d.png) is never fetched. See also #80E3 and \*not emphasis\*. > A quote, with **bold** inside. > Second quoted line. 1. First numbered 2. Second numbered - nested bullet - another nested 3. thread.text:
Two choices before this is built:
1. Where the text lives. Recommended: beside the session file — it survives the layout's prune and is deleted with the conversation.
2. Scope. Recommended: Relay agent sessions only, replay on resume.

Say "go" and I take both recommendations.

title: Scrollback survives a resume
